projects.title: DataCleanerPro — The Altorz Ribbon™ Reference Build
projects.tagline: Not a spreadsheet. A productivity product built into Excel.
projects.problem: Analysts and admin teams across every industry burn hours every week on the same manual data hygiene — fixing casing, trimming spaces, standardizing phone numbers and dates, validating emails, killing duplicates, reformatting currency. Every dataset, every week, by hand. Error-prone, soul-crushing, and impossible to scale.
projects.solution: DataCleanerPro is a custom Excel ribbon tab that installs alongside Home, Insert and Data — exactly like an enterprise add-in. 60+ one-click commands grouped into Text Casing, Trim & Clean, Numbers & INR, Dates, Emails, Phone Numbers, Duplicates, Standardization, Sheet Utilities, and a one-click Data Quality Report. Messy data in, audit-clean data out, in seconds.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment: 2–3 hour manual cleaning cycles compress to under 60 seconds. Zero manual cleaning errors. The same tool works on every file, forever. This is Reference Build #1 of the Altorz Ribbon™ methodology.
features: Custom ribbon tab — installs like an enterprise add-in
Text Casing: Upper, Lower, Proper, Sentence
Trim & Clean: spaces, non-print & special characters, blank flagging
Numbers & INR: ₹ format, Lakhs, percentage, rounding, text-to-number
Date Tools: DD-MMM-YYYY, text-to-date, invalid-date flagging
Email & Phone utilities: validate, +91 formatting, 10-digit normalization
Duplicate management: highlight, remove, count, prevent
Standardization: gender, Yes/No, name splitting, outlier flagging
Utilities: freeze header, autofit, print area, CSV export

projects.title: Executive Financial KPI Dashboard
projects.tagline: A boardroom-ready view of every metric that matters.
projects.problem: The operational reality: finance teams routinely spend 3–4 days a month assembling executive MIS — pulling numbers from ERP dumps, Tally exports, and disconnected branch spreadsheets, formatting manually, and emailing static PDFs that are stale the moment they land.
projects.solution: A single executive command center that consolidates Revenue, Profit, EBITDA, Cash Flow, and 14 supporting KPIs. Dynamic filters by region, department, quarter, and product category. One refresh button updates the entire model from source data.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: monthly reporting cycle compressed from 3–4 days to 30 minutes. Owners and CFOs review live numbers instead of last week's snapshot.
features: 12 executive KPI cards with YoY/MoM comparison
Revenue vs Expense trend with waterfall analysis

projects.title: CRM Sales Command Center
projects.tagline: An Excel-native CRM for teams who outgrew spreadsheets but not their budget.
projects.problem: The operational reality: mid-sized sales teams manage thousands of leads across a dozen disconnected spreadsheets — no pipeline visibility, no follow-up discipline, and no idea what's actually working. Dealer scheme tracking, credit-period follow-ups, and quarterly performance visibility all live in the CRM Excel or nowhere.
projects.solution: Single-workbook CRM with pipeline funnel, follow-up command center, lead source attribution, deal-stage value tracking, dealer scheme calculator, and rep performance leaderboard. Built-in alerts for overdue follow-ups.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: win-rate lift of 8+ percentage points within one quarter. Sales team runs daily standup directly from the dashboard. Dealer scheme calculations automated.

projects.title: Power Query ETL Pipeline
projects.tagline: Three messy sources in. One clean executive dashboard out.
projects.problem: The operational reality: businesses receive daily data from CSV sales exports, ERP inventory dumps, and CRM customer files — all in different formats, with inconsistent dates, duplicate records, and missing values. Manual cleaning consumes 2–3 hours every single day.
projects.solution: End-to-end Power Query ETL: ingest from three sources, apply 12 transformation steps (deduplication, type coercion, lookup merges, format standardization), output a single master analytics-ready data model.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: 3 hours of manual work compressed to 12 seconds of refresh. Zero data entry errors post-deployment.

projects.title: Inventory & Supply Chain Dashboard
projects.tagline: Stockouts cost money. This dashboard prevents them.
projects.problem: The operational reality: distributors and manufacturers with 1,000+ SKUs across multiple warehouses lose 10–15% of monthly revenue to stockouts and additional margin to overstock on slow-moving inventory — because reorder decisions depend on gut feel, not data.
projects.solution: Inventory command center with reorder point automation, ABC classification, ageing analysis, supplier OTD scorecard, demand forecasting, and warehouse utilization tracking. Directly aligned with the Altorz Inventory & Production Control System offer.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: stockout rate reduction of 60%+ within 90 days. Inventory carrying cost reduced 10–15%.

projects.title: Sales & Revenue Growth Dashboard
projects.tagline: Track revenue, growth %, and conversion in one view.
projects.problem: The operational reality: sales leadership wants YoY growth, MoM trends, regional performance, and product-mix contribution in a single screen — but existing reports are 7 different PDFs generated manually every week.
projects.solution: Unified growth dashboard with revenue trend, target-vs-achievement gauges, regional heatmap (India), top-10 customer ranking, repeat vs new customer split, and sales rep performance.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: weekly sales review cycles compressed from 90 minutes to 25 minutes. Leadership drills into outliers in real-time instead of asking analysts for cuts.

projects.title: Strategic Financial Model
projects.tagline: CFO intelligence system with scenario engine and forecasting.
projects.problem: The operational reality: growth-stage manufacturers and SMEs need investor-grade financial modeling — P&L, scenarios, cash flow, valuation, and rolling forecasts — but usually rely on static one-off models built by consultants who disappear after delivery.
projects.solution: Modular financial model with separate P&L, budget planner, forecasting engine (rolling 12), scenario analysis (5 scenarios), DCF valuation model, cash flow projection, and ratio intelligence engine. Built to be maintained by finance teams internally.
projects.outcome: Designed to serve as a company's permanent financial operating system — used monthly by finance, quarterly by leadership, and pulled into fundraising decks and board decks without rebuild.

projects.title: HR Workforce Analytics Dashboard
projects.problem: The operational reality: HR teams managing 500+ employees have no visibility into attrition risk, training ROI, or compensation distribution — every report takes 1–2 weeks to compile manually.
projects.solution: Workforce intelligence dashboard covering talent acquisition funnel, attrition trend by department, attrition risk heatmap, performance distribution, training analytics, and compensation breakdown.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: attrition risk identified 3–4 months ahead of resignation. Overall attrition reducible by 15–25% through early intervention.

projects.title: Customer Intelligence Dashboard
projects.tagline: RFM segmentation, churn prediction, and cohort retention.
projects.problem: The operational reality: B2B companies can't tell which customers are about to churn or which are their actual best segment — sales fires blind, marketing chases everyone, and revenue at-risk stays invisible until it disappears.
projects.solution: Customer intelligence dashboard with RFM segmentation matrix, churn risk distribution, churn intelligence summary, cohort retention matrix, customer lifecycle journey, and revenue contribution by segment.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: at-risk customer revenue quantified in real-time. Reactivation campaigns targeted at predicted churners can recover significant portions of otherwise-lost revenue.

projects.title: Marketing Campaign Analytics
projects.tagline: ROAS, CAC, channel attribution — across every campaign.
projects.problem: The operational reality: marketing teams running paid campaigns across 5+ channels have no unified view of ROAS, CAC, or which campaigns actually drive revenue versus just clicks. Budget waste is invisible.
projects.solution: Multi-channel campaign analytics dashboard with spend vs revenue trend, channel performance ranking, audience segment performance, device performance, budget variance waterfall, and engagement analytics.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: 20–40% of budget reallocatable away from underperforming channels within one quarter. ROAS improvements of 15–25% common.

projects.title: KPI Performance Control Tower
projects.tagline: Traffic-light KPI scoreboard for cross-functional teams.
projects.problem: The operational reality: ops directors need an at-a-glance view of every department's KPI status — financial, sales, operations, HR — without diving into 8 separate spreadsheets or waiting for the monthly review.
projects.solution: Balanced-scorecard KPI control tower with overall performance index gauge, traffic-light matrix (department × KPI category), top performer leaderboard, initiative tracker, and alerts & exceptions.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: monthly leadership reviews run from a single screen. Underperforming KPIs flagged automatically. Cross-departmental blind spots eliminated.

projects.title: Project Portfolio Gantt Dashboard
projects.tagline: Gantt timelines, resource heatmaps, and risk matrices.
projects.problem: The operational reality: PMOs and project offices managing 20–50 active projects have no real portfolio view — just individual project plans with no rollup, no cross-project resource visibility, and no early warning on risk.
projects.solution: Project portfolio command center with Gantt timeline, resource utilization heatmap, risk heatmap (impact × probability), budget variance, schedule variance gauges, and task completion funnel.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: at-risk projects identified 4–6 weeks earlier than manual review cycles. Budget variance reducible by 8–12% through early corrective action.

projects.title: HR Attendance Management System
projects.tagline: Drop-in attendance, leave, and shift management workbook.
projects.problem: The operational reality: small businesses and SMEs without a formal HRMS track attendance in unstructured spreadsheets — leading to payroll errors, leave disputes, shift confusion, and zero analytics.
projects.solution: Self-contained HR attendance template with attendance entry, leave management, shift schedule, attendance tracker, monthly heatmap, and 9 supporting analytics views.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: payroll-related disputes reducible to near-zero. Attendance analytics available in real-time instead of month-end scramble.

projects.title: Automated Invoice & Billing Generator
projects.tagline: Generate, preview, and email invoices in 10 seconds.
projects.problem: The operational reality: small consultancies, distributors, and manufacturers manually create invoices in Word or basic templates — copying client details, calculating GST/discounts/totals, and losing 3–5 hours per week to billing admin.
projects.solution: One-click invoice generator: select client from master, add line items, auto-calculate GST/discounts/totals, generate PDF preview, save to invoice history, and email via VBA. Fully GST-compliant for Indian operations.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: billing admin time reducible from 3–5 hours weekly to under 15 minutes. Invoice errors eliminated.

projects.title: Expense Reimbursement System
projects.tagline: From submission to payout — every step automated.
projects.problem: The operational reality: finance teams process 100+ expense claims per month manually — submission via email, approval via more email, reimbursement tracked in yet another spreadsheet. Turnaround is slow, policy compliance is loose, and SLA breaches are common.
projects.solution: Expense reimbursement management system with claim submission form, approval workflow, payment tracking, policy compliance scoring, and full reporting layer.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: claim processing time reducible from 7–10 days to 2–3 days. Policy compliance scoring built-in.

projects.title: Sales Commission Calculator
projects.tagline: Commission rules engine with accelerators and bonuses.
projects.problem: The operational reality: sales-driven companies with 30+ reps calculate commissions manually with tiered rates, accelerators, retention bonuses, and quarterly performance bonuses — 2–3 days of payroll work every month, full of errors and disputes.
projects.solution: Commission calculator with slab rules engine, accelerator logic, bonus rules (retention, top performer, campaign), payout statement generator, and forecasted commission projections. Directly applicable to dealer scheme calculations for manufacturers.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: commission processing time reducible from 2–3 days to under 60 minutes. Payout disputes reducible to near-zero.

projects.title: Monthly Budget vs Actual Tracker
projects.tagline: Plan, track, control, and analyze — month after month.
projects.problem: The operational reality: ops and finance teams set monthly budgets but have no way to track variance until the month ends — by which time corrective action is too late and overspends have already hit the P&L.
projects.solution: Budget vs actual tracker with rolling variance analysis, waterfall variance visualization, forecast & runway calculator, department-wise utilization, alerts on overspend, and executive insights panel.
projects.outcome: Reference deployment target: overspending detected mid-month instead of month-end. Cash runway visibility expandable from 1 month to 3+ months ahead.
